name: Meronothite
brief: A term used to describe two individuals in the Bible
short: Meronothite, a term used to describe Jehdeiah, who was in charge of King David's donkeys (<ref="1Ch.27.30">1Ch.27.30</ref>), and Jadon, who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem (<ref="Nehemiah 3:7">Nehemiah 3:7</ref>).
